reason: I already have a brand I reorder when it runs out, and I'm not going to switch on a first look from a brand I've never heard of. My doctor said my magnesium could be low, but I'd ask her what to take before buying a new one.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone sounds like less for the same money, and I don't know this brand.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor or a friend I trust telling me bisglycinate alone is what I need, or a lab-confirmed result showing my magnesium is low and that this form is the right one.
